content.text:
`/methodology` currently falls through the catchall loader and becomes an invalid route. The smallest change is a `methodology` `PageModel` case, recognized before invalid-route handling, with an `App.svelte` branch so it reuses the existing shell.

A dedicated SvelteKit route keeps methodology separate from entity routing, but the shared shell currently lives inside `App.svelte`, so that option also requires extracting or reshaping the shell. Either approach should keep a skip link with a matching target, one main landmark and page heading, and clear navigation back to search.
